title: CILIATE: Towards Fairer Class-based Incremental Learning by Dataset and Training Refinement
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on addressing and fixing 'fairness issues' in class-based incremental learning models. Fairness is a significant ethical consideration in machine learning and AI, as it directly relates to equitable treatment and non-discrimination by AI systems. The paper explicitly aims to make AI systems 'fairer,' which is an ethical objective, and dedicates substantial discussion and evaluation to this aspect, beyond a mere 'ethical considerations' section.
